quote: We expect capital expenditures to be approximately US$3 billion over the three-year period from 2026 to 2028. The breakdown is as follows: approximately 60% for Novandino, 20% for the Iodine and Plant Nutrition Division, and 20% for the International Lithium Division. This estimate includes approximately US$300 million per year of sustaining capital expenditures across all divisions.
note: Opened SQM SEC 6-K English earnings release 2026-10-04.
